name: fast-jev-output-floor
description: Trim long Bash output with Jev before the model sees it (Claude Code plugin)

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

minTokens.title: Minimum Bash output tokens
minTokens.description: Stdout at or below this estimated token count passes through untouched. Minimum: the minTokensFloor option (default 10000).

minTokensFloor.title: Floor under the minimum Bash output tokens
minTokensFloor.description: Lowest value minTokens can take; upstream fixes it at 10000 (agent-factory local option, vendor/jev-pruner/PROVENANCE.md). Lowering it changes nothing unless minTokens is lowered too. A value below 0 or not finite counts as 10000.

persistedOutputs.title: Prune output the engine saved
persistedOutputs.description: When Bash output is too large to show inline, prune the saved file instead of leaving the model a head-of-file preview.

persistedMaxChars.title: Budget for engine-saved output
persistedMaxChars.description: Rendered character budget including omission markers and the archive footer, also capped by the native model-visible preview when available. If errors or unscored content cannot fit safely, the original result passes through. 0 disables this configured cap; the native preview cap still applies.

chunkLines.title: Bash output chunk lines
chunkLines.description: Number of Bash output lines grouped into each Jev chunk.

chunkChars.title: Bash output chunk character target
chunkChars.description: Optional character target instead of line grouping. Preserves line boundaries after long-line splitting; adjacent chunks merge if needed to stay within 200 decisions. 0 uses chunkLines.

diagnostics.title: Log pruning decisions
diagnostics.description: Log skip reasons, source and hook-returned character counts, request counts, and elapsed time. Does not include commands or output content. Hook counts are not final model-visible token counts.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability for a Bash output chunk to stay visible.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the Bash output state sent to Jev.

maxScoringRequests.title: Maximum additional scoring requests
maxScoringRequests.description: Additional Jev calls beyond the first, shared by scoring, retries and refinement. The hook also limits total calls to one per 192 visible preview characters, rounded up. 0 permits only the initial call.

baseUrl.title: System One endpoint URL
baseUrl.description: Overrides https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, e.g. a local relay or a local model server. agent-factory local change 3.

archiveDir.title: Archive folder
archiveDir.description: Where a trimmed output's full text is saved for recovery. Default .claude/fast-jev-output. agent-factory local change 3.

decisionsDir.title: Decision record folder
decisionsDir.description: If set, every Bash call rewrites last.json here, and a call past the size floor also writes <UTC day>/<time>-<tool use id>.json. Counts only, never the command or the output. agent-factory local change 3.
